title: Personal Hardship Assistance, East Coast Severe Weather – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information for the Personal Hardship Assistance Grant following major flooding in the East Coast of NSW.
intro: Service NSW on behalf of the NSW Reconstruction Authority is offering financial support (the Grant) to individuals in the East Coast of NSW impacted by major flooding from the East Coast Severe Weather disaster event, from 18 May 2025. Individuals that were impacted by major flooding in the Local Government.
who_can_apply: Be an individual in the East Coast of NSW.
Be impacted by major flooding from the East Coast Severe Weather disaster event, starting from 18 May 2025.
what_you_need: Evidence that you resided at an address located in the impacted area

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

internal_links.text: Personal Hardship Assistance, East Coast Severe Weather

faqs.a: The grant offers financial support to individuals in the East Coast of NSW who were impacted by major flooding from the East Coast Severe Weather disaster event, starting from 18 May 2025.
Information collected includes your full name, date of birth, contact details, residential address, bank details, and evidence of identity and residence in the impacted area.

faqs.q: How will my information be used?
faqs.a: Your information will be used to process your application, pay the Grant, contact you about future supports, and conduct audits or investigations to ensure eligibility.
